headline: Aequs approves grant of two lakh employee stock options
hook: New stock options for Aequs team
summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Aequs Limited approved the grant of 2,00,000 employee stock options at its meeting on October 26, 2026. The grants are issued under the Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025. This routine corporate action dilutes existing equity slightly while incentivizing employees. Indian retail investors tracking micro-cap corporate governance note standard ESOP issuances.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution from new employee stock option grants.

headline: Aequs Limited holds extraordinary general meeting
summary: Aequs Limited conducted an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) on October 22, 2026. The company has formally notified the NSE regarding the proceedings of this meeting. No specific agenda items or resolutions passed were disclosed in the initial filing.
